marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 20 knots diminishing to east 15 early this evening and
to light near midnight. Wind becoming south 15 Sunday evening. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 to 2 this
morning and to 1 this evening.<br/>
